notes.title: Balancing update, Discord server & new language
notes.content:
Dear players,

as always, thank you for the great support and interest in a game that is now over 3 years old. 

I have been testing some balance updates in the last months and will share them with you soon. Primarily it's about the late game and the balancing of the individual staff as well as the streaming platform. 

Additionally, I have been working with a service provider to create a Chinese version of Series Makers. We hope to integrate this in the update as well.

I also finally created a community Discord server. Also to give you space for feedback. We are also looking for moderators here, so feel free to contact me directly.

https://discord.gg/rWnWGGsa

We are looking forward to the next updates!

Best regards
Simon

notes.title: Update: New Language and Balancing Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players,

First of all: Sorry for not getting in touch for such a long time. Many of you know that Series Makers Tycoon is a passionate hobby of mine, but at the end of the day it's just a hobby. In the course of the last two years many things happened to me privately. New jobs, five moves, family problems and more. 

Nevertheless, we have continued to work on Series Makers Tycoon over the last two years and released a version for Android and iOS last year. This year I would like to do some balancing updates and add the Chinese language, as many of you have asked for it.

I'm looking forward to working more on Series Makers Tycoon soon and who knows, if I have enough time and money, to add more features.

Best regards
Simon

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: First major update | 2 new languages | Portuguese and Russian
notes.content:
Dear gamers,

we have just released the first update. Some bugs have been fixed, some balance improvements have been made and two new languages have been introduced: Portuguese and Russian. 

We fixed some graphical bugs, small calculation errors in streaming and the experience.

Even though I don't speak these languages myself, with the help of two native speakers I was able to achieve a suitable translation.

I hope you continue to have fun with Series Makers and look forward to future updates!

Best regards
Simon
